Figure caption: Schematic illustration of hybrid lipidoids (Cdoids) for intranasal cancer vaccine. (A) Schematic illustration of the Cdoids and Lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) made using them. Cdoids LNP was inoculated intranasally into mice. (B) Cdoids LNPs could internalization both clathrin-mediated endocytosis and caveolae-mediated endocytosis pathway, that increased compared to general LNPs. (C) There is no tissue toxicity observed when excessive doses of Cdoids were delivered intranasally that demonstrate excellent biocompatibility of Cdoids. (D) Schematic representation of the immune response in mice following vaccination. Dendritic cells that recognize the antigen (OVA in this experiment) migrate to the lymph nodes; they activate immune cells. Upon subsequent recognition of the same antigen, tumor cells are eradicated by CD8 + T cells (via IFN-γ secretion) and the humoral immune response, including IgG and IgA, at the tumor site

Figure caption: Characterization of Cdots and Cdot-oleic acid conjugates (Cdoids). (A) The TEM image of Cdot. (B) Full scan XPS spectrum of Cdots and (C) N 1 s spectrum. (D) UV spectrum of Cdots, Oleic acid and Cdoids. (E) The critical micelle concentration (CMC) determination of Cdots and Cdoids. (F) The hydrodynamic size distribution of Cdots and Cdoids. (G) Fluorescent intensity and Transmittance values of Cdots and Cdoids. (H) pKa value of Cdots and Cdoids using strong acid with strong base titration (I) Comparison of cytotocity with conventional oleyl phospholipid and commercial ionizable lipid. All of cytotoxicity data were triplicate. n.s., not significant. one-way ANOVA and Tukey’s multiple comparison test

Figure caption: Characterization of Cdoids formulation. (A) Schematic Images of the Cdoids and Lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) made using them. (B) size and PDI of Cdoids LNP (Cdoids X, X = 1 ~ 13) according to different ratios of Cdoids and lipid constituents (C) Comparison pKa of Cdot, Cdoids, and Cdoids LNP. (D) Size distribution and surface zeta potential of Cdoids 11 (E) Internal structure of Cdoids LNP as determined by TEM and (F) cryo-TEM. Red circle means Cdots. White scale bar = 50 nm, Black scale bar = 20 nm

Figure caption: Evaluation of mRNA delivery efficiency and biocompatibility of Cdoids. (A) In vitro Firefly luciferase (FLuc) luminescence according to the ratio of different lipid components. (B) Comparison of in vitro FLuc luminescence using HeLa cells. (C) Comparison of FLuc luminescence for elucidating the intracellular uptake mechanism of mRNA@SM-102 (G4) and mRNA@Cdoids (G5). **p < 0.01, ***p < 0.001, Two-way ANOVA with Tukey’s multiple comparison test. (D) CLSM images for confirming intracellular uptake and mRNA release of G5. (E) Enlargement image in Fig. 4D, G5_merge 1. White scale bar = 50 μm. (F) In vivo Luciferase luminescence images 6 h after intranasal administration of G4 and G5. (G) Quantification of luminescence expressed in the nasal cavity in G4 and G5. Statistical Analysis performed via student’s t test. H-I) ex vivo Luciferase expression test. (H) Quantification of luminescence expressed in the nasal cavity at Fig. 4I. *: vs. PBS, #: vs. G4. (I) luminescence images in major organs 6 h after intranasal administration each sample. J-L) H&E staining was conducted to evaluate histological toxicity 24 h after administering a 440-fold higher dose Cdoids (relative to the standard dose, n = 10). (J) Nasal olfactory epithelium K) Lung L) Liver. Black scale bar = 500 μm. *p < 0.05; **p < 0.01; ***p < 0.001. G1:PBS, G2:Free mRNA, G3: Blank Cdoids, G4: mRNA@SM-102, G5: mRNA@Cdoids. one-way ANOVA and Tukey’s multiple comparison test

Figure caption: In vivo cancer vaccine activity confirmation. A) In vivo tumor growth inhibition test schedule through intranasal injection. B) Tumor volume change observed for 21 days after tumor injection and C) Body weight change. D) Cancer tissues from each group isolated at the end point. Each large notch is 1 cm. E) Tumor volume change observed for 21 days for each group. Data were represented as mean ± SD, n=6 biologically independent samples (B, C, E). *p < 0.05; **p < 0.01; ***p < 0.001. G1:PBS, G2:Free mRNA, G3: Blank Cdoids, G4: mRNA@SM-102, G5: mRNA@Cdoids. One-way ANOVA and Tukey’s multiple comparison test

Figure caption: Confirmation of immunologic response via nasal administration. (A) Process diagram of obtaining CD8 + T cells. (B) Live&dead assay confocal image for confirming CD8 + T cell cytotoxicity using wild type B16-F10 cells (B16-F10_wt) and OVA-overexpressing B16-F10 cells (B16-F10_OVA). C-F) Quantitative experiment on immune factors (IgG, IgA) increased by vaccination. (C) Total IgG, (D) Total IgA, (E) OVA specific IgG, (F) OVA specific IgA. G-J) Interferon gamma (IFN-γ) ELISpot test using CD8 + T cells. (G) ELISpot image using Ovalbumin whole protein and (H) number of spots. (I) ELISpot image using CD8 + recognition Ovalbumin peptide and (J) number of spots. Data were represented as mean ± SD, n = 3 biologically independent samples (C-F), n = 5 biologically independent samples (H, J). *p < 0.05; **p < 0.01; ***p < 0.001. G1:PBS, G2:Free mRNA, G3: Blank Cdoids, G4: mRNA@SM-102, G5: mRNA@Cdoids. One-way ANOVA and Dunnett multiple comparison test. *: vs. PBS, #: vs. G4
